database_summary: Small OLTP-style sales/product schema (SQLite). Core entities: product catalog (product, productcategory, productsubcategory, productdescription, productmodelproductdescriptionculture, productreview), sales orders (salesorderheader, salesorderdetail) and sales organization (salesperson, salesterritory, SalesPersonQuotaHistory). Auxiliary currency tables (currencyrate, countryregioncurrency). Row counts indicate products (~504), orders (~31k headers, 121k details) and modest territory/salesperson lookup tables. Many tables hold current descriptive state (product, productcategory, salesterritory), some hold transactional/event rows (salesorderheader, salesorderdetail, productreview, SalesPersonQuotaHistory, currencyrate), and one mapping table for localized descriptions (productmodelproductdescriptionculture).

accepted.name: product_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  NAME,
  productnumber,
  makeflag,
  finishedgoodsflag,
  color,
  safetystocklevel,
  reorderpoint,
  standardcost,
  listprice,
  size,
  sizeunitmeasurecode,
  weightunitmeasurecode,
  weight,
  daystomanufacture,
  productline,
  class,
  style,
  productsubcategoryid,
  productmodelid,
  sellstartdate,
  sellenddate,
  discontinueddate,
  rowguid,
  modifieddate
FROM product
WHERE 1=1
accepted.description: Normalized product dimension: one row per product with core descriptive attributes and numeric measures. Useful as a clean product lookup when joining to sales, reviews, or category/subcategory. Preserves product identifiers and important measures. | Use for: Look up product attributes for a productid or set of productids; Join product attributes to sales/order line fact table; Filter products by lifecycle dates (sellstartdate/sellenddate/discontinueddate)

accepted.name: product_with_category
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.productid,
  p.NAME,
  p.productnumber,
  p.productsubcategoryid,
  ps.productcategoryid,
  ps.name AS name,
  pc.productcategoryid AS productcategoryid,
  pc.name AS name,
  p.productmodelid,
  p.listprice,
  p.standardcost,
  p.rowguid,
  p.modifieddate
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid
accepted.description: Product rows joined to their subcategory and category names. One row per product, exposing hierarchical category labels for easier reporting and grouping. | Use for: Report sales by product category or subcategory; Filter products by category for inventory or pricing analysis; Aggregate product counts or measures by category/subcategory

accepted.name: product_reviews_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  AVG(rating) AS avg_rating
FROM productreview
GROUP BY productid
accepted.description: Aggregated review metrics per product: count of reviews and average rating. Useful to join to products or orders to analyze product satisfaction or to filter by review popularity. | Use for: Find products with highest/lowest average rating; Filter products with at least N reviews; Join review aggregates to product catalog or sales

accepted.name: sales_order_line_amounts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  salesorderid,
  salesorderdetailid,
  carriertrackingnumber,
  orderqty,
  productid,
  specialofferid,
  unitprice,
  unitpricediscount,
  (unitprice * orderqty * (1.0 - COALESCE(unitpricediscount,0.0))) AS line_total,
  rowguid,
  modifieddate
FROM salesorderdetail
accepted.description: Normalized sales order line with computed line amounts. One row per salesorderdetail presenting monetary measures (extended amount considering unitpricediscount). Useful as the canonical sales order line fact for aggregation. | Use for: Compute total revenue/units per product/order/period; Join order line totals to headers for order-level analytics; Filter or rank top-selling products by revenue or quantity

accepted.name: sales_orders_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  soh.salesorderid,
  soh.orderdate,
  soh.duedate,
  soh.shipdate,
  soh.STATUS,
  soh.onlineorderflag,
  soh.customerid,
  soh.salespersonid,
  soh.territoryid,
  soh.subtotal,
  soh.taxamt,
  soh.freight,
  soh.totaldue,
  soh.rowguid,
  soh.modifieddate,
  s.businessentityid AS businessentityid,
  s.territoryid AS territoryid,
  st.territoryid AS territoryid,
  st.name AS name,
  st.countryregioncode AS countryregioncode,
  st.[group] AS [group]
FROM salesorderheader soh
LEFT JOIN salesperson s ON soh.salespersonid = s.businessentityid
LEFT JOIN salesterritory st ON soh.territoryid = st.territoryid
accepted.description: Sales order header joined with salesperson and territory info. One row per salesorderid exposing header-level measures and organizational attributes for reporting or rollups. | Use for: Analyze sales by salesperson or territory; Filter orders by orderdate or salesperson attributes; Compute territory-level KPIs by aggregating headers

accepted.name: sales_order_lines_with_product
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  sod.salesorderid,
  sod.salesorderdetailid,
  sod.orderqty,
  sod.productid,
  sod.unitprice,
  sod.unitpricediscount,
  sod.rowguid AS rowguid,
  p.productid AS productid,
  p.NAME AS NAME,
  p.productnumber AS productnumber,
  p.productsubcategoryid AS productsubcategoryid,
  p.productmodelid AS productmodelid,
  pa.review_count AS review_count,
  pa.avg_rating AS avg_rating,
  (sod.unitprice * sod.orderqty * (1.0 - COALESCE(sod.unitpricediscount,0.0))) AS line_total
FROM salesorderdetail sod
LEFT JOIN product p ON sod.productid = p.productid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT productid, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating
  FROM productreview
  GROUP BY productid
) pa ON p.productid = pa.productid
accepted.description: Sales order detail joined to product dimension and aggregated review metrics. One row per sales order line including product attributes, category ids, and review summary useful for combined sales and product-quality analysis. | Use for: Revenue by product including product metadata and review signals; Identify products with high revenue but low average rating; Join sales lines to product categories and models for inventory planning

accepted.name: salesperson_quota_history_latest
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BusinessEntityID,
  QuotaDate,
  SalesQuota,
  rowguid,
  ModifiedDate
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessEntityID ORDER BY QuotaDate DESC, ModifiedDate DESC) AS rn
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
) t
WHERE rn = 1
accepted.description: Latest SalesPerson quota row per BusinessEntityID using latest QuotaDate. One row per salesperson's most recent quota record; useful when comparing current quota to sales performance. | Use for: Compare latest quota to salesperson salesytd or saleslastyear; Filter salespeople by most recent quota value; Join latest quota to salesperson master record

accepted.name: currency_rates_by_date
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  currencyratedate,
  fromcurrencycode,
  tocurrencycode,
  AVG(averagerate) AS avg_averagerate,
  AVG(endofdayrate) AS avg_endofdayrate
FROM currencyrate
GROUP BY currencyratedate, fromcurrencycode, tocurrencycode
accepted.description: Daily currency rate averages per from/to currency pair. One row per currencyratedate and pair aggregating available rates. Useful to join to orders to convert totals to a common currency. | Use for: Convert order totals between currencies by joining on order date; Analyze currency movements by pair over time
